ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High; predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels covering ~85% of visible surface area, bordered by low-intensity (black) pixels along the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric regions in central and outer lobes; thick, irregular black banding (5-15 pixel width) along the entire trailing edge; localized dark mottling near the median notch and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; approximately 40-degree internal angle with a high-depth bounding box relative to lobe chord length.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; notable negative-amplitude spike (large indentation) on the left lobe trailing edge; right lobe exhibits moderate-amplitude rhythmic serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the notch transitioning to a tapered, slightly upturned concave sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast, textured clusters (white on black and dark on white) localized at both the extreme left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single dark diagonal linear disruption visible on the right lobe surface; multiple vertical high-contrast rake marks intersecting the black trailing edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular notch/tissue loss on the mid-trailing edge of the left lobe; distinct jagged indentation on the inner-left lobe near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant textured calcification or bio-fouling clusters at the extreme distal tips.
